title: On the Midwatch Snack Edition – Candy Bars
description:
On this episode of On The Midwatch Snack Edition, U.S. and Australian Submariners try snacks from both countries – Butterfinger vs. Violet Crumble - and give us their opinion on which snack gets an All Ahead Full, and which snack is TDU. 

AAF or All Ahead Full is a term used to give full agreement or support for a command or action. On a military submarine, a TDU stands for Trash Disposal Unit, a specialized vertical ejection system—similar to a small, internal vertical torpedo tube—used to safely get rid of waste and garbage while remaining submerged and hidden. TDU is also submarine slang for disliking and not approving of something. 

Video hosted by STSC Antonio Maldonado, filmed and edited by Brian Powell, and produced by Lauren Belknap.
